Done. Scaffolded `unpipe-server`:

- `src/unpipe.js` — `trackDestinations(readable)` records every `.pipe()` target and exposes `unpipeAll()`; the one-shot `unpipeAll(readable)` works with or without tracking and falls back to native `readable.unpipe()`.
- `src/index.js` — HTTP server (`/health`, `/events` SSE, `/disconnect-all`) that pipes one shared tick stream to many responses and detaches them all via the tracker.
- `test/unpipe.test.js` — 6 passing tests covering multi-destination detach, untracked streams, idempotency, dest-error cleanup, and un-patching.
